name: Accretion
author: E. T. Carter
description: A black hole hanging over a low black puck, ringed by its disc. Light bends round the hole, so the far side of the disc shows over the top and underneath, with a thin ring of light hugging the black. The disc spins fastest on the inside, shearing its streaks into spirals, and the side coming toward you burns brighter. Every half minute a star drifts in and is torn into a stream that winds down to the inner edge; the disc flares and two jets fire out along the axis.

sculpture.label: A black hole and its disc, the far side bent up over the top. Every half minute a star is torn apart and falls in, and two jets fire.

params.label: Feed
params.effect: How often a star falls in: 1 is every half minute, lower waits longer, 0 leaves the disc quiet.

params.label: Glow
params.effect: How bright the disc and the jets burn.

params.label: Turn
params.effect: How fast the axis swings round: 1 is once a minute, tipping the disc from edge on to open and back; 0 holds it.

params.label: Mouse influence
params.effect: How far the pointer orbits the camera round the piece; 0 ignores the mouse.
